title: De'Longhi Rivelia Start Fully Automatic Coffee Machine Beige $859 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: De'Longhi Rivelia Start Fully Automatic Coffee Machine Beige $859 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[totororo] https://www.myer.com.au/p/de-aposlonghi-rivelia-start-fully-…
Same price as myer
[HHH18] I have the Full spec Rivelia machine at home and it's brilliant. The Rivelia Start has slightly less features but will still make a good selection of drinks. For a very small office maybe… but the water tank, bean hopper and puck tray are all small and you'll be emptying and refilling them all day long for anything more than 2-4 people. Otherwise, I've put 2500 coffee through my machine in 18months and it's great.
[mollicharles] Exactly as the other comment. It is slim and smart so not a very good option for more than 4 to 5 people using at once.
[HHH18] https://www.harveynorman.com.au/delonghi-rivelia-automatic-c…
This is the full spec Rivelia for $1144 in a few colours at a really decent price.
[mollicharles] I just noticed that this is a different machine / variant. Thanks for pointing this out.
[WhyNoYes] the plastic milk container would be a bit concerning for me heating up milk in that surely wouldn't be great.
[Ry34] its purely a container for cold milk, the heating is done once the milk is sucked out of the plastic container
[Archiebald] This or De'Longhi Magnifica Plus? The later is the recent model that has very good reviews so far. Does Rivelia produce the same (or better) quality of coffee? I'm also considering Primadonna series but that's a different league.
[HHH18] Primadonna, Eletta, Maestosa and Rivelia are the top machines when I did my research last year. Would have gone for one the first 2 but couldn't resist a really great deal on the Rivelia at the time.
[mollicharles] There are slight differences, also in eventual temperature of the coffee, for that you need to see lots of reviews if you are touchy about that. This is a good review video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JoKFhWzMJVo
In my personal experience the milk coffee's are generally hotter in Magnifica range as compare to Eletta and Primadonna (I prefer hot), Rivelia is a good middle ground though, it is slim and have a slightly different brew group as Magnifica, but I think it can give you larger puck as the top end machines from De'Longhi.
Magnifica Plus is an awesome machine but I haven't seen that on discount for at least a year or so, minimal as compared to other models. Summing up all this, at this price point Rivelia is probably a better choice.
[mollicharles] I just noticed that this is a different machine / variant. Rivelia Fully Automatic vs Rivelia Start
[jizmo] I always wanted to buy this to replace my working magnifica, but when I saw these at the shop side by side with other machines, I'll give it a miss. This model is a lot smaller than the other machines, which can be a good thing, but it looks an feels cheap and plastic
